async def tuple_reset(items, pairs, read):
    saved = None
    for item in items:
        saved, other = pairs[item]
        if saved is None:
            # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
            saved = await read(item)


async def list_reset(items, pairs, read):
    saved = None
    for item in items:
        [other, saved] = pairs[item]
        if saved is None:
            # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
            saved = await read(item)


async def nested_tuple_reset(items, pairs, read):
    saved = None
    for item in items:
        ((other, saved), tail) = pairs[item]
        if saved is None:
            # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
            saved = await read(item)


async def nested_list_reset(items, pairs, read):
    saved = None
    for item in items:
        [other, (saved, tail)] = pairs[item]
        if saved is None:
            # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
            saved = await read(item)


async def unrelated_reset(items, pairs, read):
    saved = None
    for item in items:
        other, tail = pairs[item]
        if saved is None:
            saved = await read(item)
